parts.title: A day I will never forget
parts.instructions: Read the article and choose the best answer for each question.
parts.passage:
It was the hottest day of the summer, and we decided to spend it at the beach. My mother packed sandwiches, and my brother and I took our bodyboards. We arrived at ten, and the sand was already warm under our feet.

I was so excited about the waves that I forgot to put on sun cream. My mother called out, but I did not hear her. For four hours, I jumped through the waves and built a huge sand castle with my cousins.

By the afternoon, my back felt strange. When I took off my T-shirt, my mother gasped. My skin was bright red! That evening, it hurt so much that I could not lie down. I spent the night sitting in a chair with a wet towel on my shoulders.

The next week, my skin peeled like a snake's. It was a painful way to learn, but I never forgot. Now I put on cream before I leave the house, and I check it again every two hours.

parts.title: Protecting your skin
parts.instructions: Choose the sentence that fits each gap. There is one extra sentence.
parts.passage:
Sunshine feels wonderful, and it helps our bodies to make vitamin D. [1] Too much sun, however, can be harmful, so it is important to take care.

The sun is strongest in the middle of the day. [2] If possible, stay in the shade between twelve and three, and plan outdoor games for the morning or the evening.

Sun cream is your best friend. [3] Choose one with a high number, and put it on again after swimming, even if the label says that it is waterproof.

Clothes help, too. [4] A loose shirt with long sleeves is cooler than you think, and it protects your arms from burning.

Finally, drink plenty of water. [5] Your body loses a lot of liquid when it is hot, and you may not feel thirsty until it is too late.
sentences: Put it on thirty minutes before you go out.
A hat with a wide brim protects your face and neck.
Most people feel happier on a sunny day.
Many people forget to do this on holiday.
This is true even on cloudy days.
Ice cream is a popular treat on the beach.

gaps.explanation: Feeling happier on a sunny day follows the vitamin D idea; the next sentence says too much sun is harmful.
The sun is strongest at midday, even on cloudy days; the next sentence says to stay in the shade.
Sun cream is your best friend; put it on thirty minutes early; the next sentence says to choose a high number.
A hat protects the face and neck; the next sentence adds a loose shirt as another piece of clothing.
Many people forget to drink on holiday; the next sentence explains that the body loses liquid.

parts.title: Why the sea is salty
parts.instructions: Write one word in each gap.
parts.passage: Have you ever wondered why the sea is salty? Rivers carry tiny amounts of salt from rocks into the oceans. The sun heats the water, and some of it turns [1] vapour and rises into the sky. The salt cannot rise, so it stays behind. Over millions of years, the sea has become saltier. In some places, the water is [2] salty that it is easy to float. In the Dead Sea, for example, you can read a newspaper while lying on the surface. Of course, it is not a good idea [3] drink sea water. It contains too much salt, [4] it makes you thirsty instead of helping you. Sailors who are lost at sea often get ill because they do not have any fresh water. Scientists are now looking for cheap ways to remove the salt, [5] that people in dry countries can drink from the sea. This could change life for millions of [6].

gaps.explanation: Turns into vapour: change of state.
So salty that it is easy to float: result.
It is not a good idea to drink sea water.
And joins two facts about too much salt.
So that gives the purpose: so that people can drink.
Millions of people is the common phrase.

parts.title: A message from a surf school
parts.instructions: Listen to the talk and complete each note. Write one or two words, a number, a date or a time.

turns.speaker: instructor
turns.text: Hello, this is Ode from Wave Surf School. I am calling to confirm your lesson for Saturday. Please arrive at the beach hut by nine o'clock, because the tide is best in the morning. The lesson lasts two hours and costs thirty-five pounds, which includes the board and the wetsuit. Bring a towel, a swimming costume and plenty of sun cream. You should eat a light breakfast, but not too close to the lesson. We have a maximum of six students in each group, so you will get lots of attention. If the sea is too rough, we will have to change the date, and I will phone you on Friday evening. After the lesson, you can buy a hot chocolate at the beach cafe. I hope you enjoy your first time on a board!

gaps.explanation: He says the lesson is on Saturday.

gaps.prompt: Students must arrive at the beach hut by ___ o'clock
gaps.explanation: He says to arrive by nine.
He says the lesson lasts two hours.
He says it costs thirty-five pounds.

gaps.explanation: He says there are six students in each group.

gaps.prompt: If the sea is rough, he will phone on ___ evening

parts.title: An interview with a lifeguard
parts.instructions: Listen to the interview and choose the correct answer.

turns.speaker: i
turns.text: Ramsey, how long have you been a lifeguard?

turns.speaker: h
turns.text: Eight summers. I started at eighteen, and I have not missed a season since.

turns.speaker: i
turns.text: What does the job involve?

turns.speaker: h
turns.text: Mostly watching. I sit in my tower and scan the water. People think it is easy, but you have to concentrate all the time.

turns.speaker: i
turns.text: How often do you rescue someone?

turns.speaker: h
turns.text: About ten times in a summer. Usually, it is a child on an inflatable who has drifted too far from the shore.

turns.speaker: i
turns.text: What is the biggest danger at the beach?

turns.speaker: h
turns.text: Currents. They can carry a strong swimmer out in seconds. Most people do not see them, so I always tell them to swim between the flags.

turns.speaker: i
turns.text: Do you have any tips for swimmers?

turns.speaker: h
turns.text: Never swim alone, never swim after a big meal, and respect the red flag.

turns.speaker: i
turns.text: What do you do in winter?

turns.speaker: h
turns.text: I teach swimming at the indoor pool. I love it, but I miss the sea.
